allocation.declaration: Constructive analysis of frozen four-cell observations, no new simulation. Equal probability for adding actor first versus second: phiA=(mAI-mII+mAH-mIH)/2; phiH=(mIH-mII+mAH-mAI)/2. Per-context identity phiA+phiH=mAH-mII checked exactly. Symmetric order weighting is an explicit allocation convention, NOT uniquely selected by rules or evidence of stable material prices. Immobile occupancy baseline, conditional law and one-ply terminal task remain essential inputs. Fractions are exact averages of finite observed cohorts, not exact population probabilities. No human labels/normalization/defaults. Preserve sparse zeros; zero empirical variance is not zero uncertainty.

broad.scope: Interaction is paired mAH-mIH-mAI+mII for existence of a legal immediate win. Conditional population and virtual immobile interventions; descriptive goal mechanism, not material prices or causal decomposition of long games. Approximate normal intervals are development diagnostics only, especially sparse counts. No population/weights chosen from results.

shogi_goal.declaration: Changed semantic mechanism, not another random mate sweep: fixed sparse StandardShogi starts ownK0,0 N3,2 G6,7 B6,5, enemyK8,8 N1,8 and targetP/G4,4. Actual Ncapture3,2to4,4 then enemyN1,8to0,6 yields a real hand and full history. Three predeclared cells:P original rule,P removing ONLY pawn-drop S4 postconditions,G original rule. Enumerate every legal current action/terminal; all route roots and child full Native/Core parity. Test whether pawn-drop-mate prohibition changes terminal-goal opportunity despite genuine hand acquisition; expected P drop8,7 forbidden, allowed and mating withoutS4, G mating drop allowed. Preserve every outcome and competing wins, not just expected witness. Synthetic sparse initial inventory, no opening reachability or material-price/strength claim. One30sec checkpoint, no enlargement.

terminal_weight.scope: Algebra on the already exposed exact finite-policy vector, no new simulation, selected weight or human labels. C(lambda)=U+lambda*win applies only to these all-no-loss/no-draw cells. Rule-only illustrative normalization win+U/81 makes terminalwin1 and ongoing endpoint<=80/81 at a leaf; this is an explicit utility convention, not calibrated WDL or uniquely implied price. Independent expected-value comparisons still depend on behavioral/context laws.
